job_description:
We are looking for a Python Backend Engineer to build high-performance microservices.
Requirements:
- 0-2 years experience with Python, FastAPI, Flask, or Django
- Solid knowledge of SQL (PostgreSQL), RESTful API design, and Redis caching
- Familiarity with Docker, Git version control, and CI/CD pipelines
- Understanding of distributed systems, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ) is a strong plus.

recommended_learning_topics.description: Learn asynchronous messaging, pub/sub mechanics, producer/consumer models, and event-driven backend design.
resources: Designing Data-Intensive Applications by Martin Kleppmann

recommended_learning_topics.description: Understand service discovery, API gateways, fault tolerance, circuit breakers, and eventual consistency in microservice architectures.
resources: System Design Interview by Alex Xu

recommended_learning_topics.description: Master async ORM patterns with SQLAlchemy, connection pooling, complex SQL queries, and caching strategies using Redis.

suggested_preparation_roadmap.step: Step 1: Deep Dive into Async Python & Advanced FastAPI

focus_areas: RabbitMQ exchange types and queue mechanics
Kafka topics, partitions, and consumer groups

suggested_preparation_roadmap.step: Step 3: Build a Distributed Microservices Project
focus_areas: Containerizing multiple services via Docker Compose
Automated CI/CD pipeline set up with GitHub Actions

suggested_preparation_roadmap.step: Step 4: System Design & Mock Interview Preparation
focus_areas: Scaling relational databases and distributed caching
Resume refinement focusing on Python backend impact
